description: Four mutes on one panel, each stopping its input while its button is latched on or a gate is high

params.text: Latches that channel's mute on and off, and lights while the mute is on

inputs.text: The signal that channel passes while it is not muted
Mutes that channel while this reads above 0V, whatever the button is set to

outputs.text: Carries that channel's input while the channel is not muted, and 0V while it is

notes: the lit state is the stopped state: a channel with its light on is passing 0V, not passing signal
